title: Explicit Hamiltonian ball packings in every dimension
description:
For every k ≥ 10 and ε ∈ (0,1), we define one explicit smooth compactly supported Hamiltonian on ℝ × ℝ⁴ whose time-one map carries the k closed unit balls centred at (3i−3,0,0,0) into the ball of radius (k/(1−ε/4))1/4, with an explicit stability margin: a mathematical solution to Epoch AI's symplectic ball packing problem. The same construction realises every ball packing allowed by the volume and two-ball inequalities in dimension 2n ≥ 6 and the packings with Σci² < C² and 3ci < C in dimension four, and proves Biran's packing stability for B⁴ without J-holomorphic curves. A uniform terminating algorithm outputs a rational polynomial times a fixed cutoff with the same packing property.

Contains the paper, its supplement with complete proofs, and a Lean 4 formalisation of the main packing, stability and algorithm theorems.

Source and verification instructions: Symplectic-Ball-Packing. The algorithm theorem does not assert a practical runtime bound.
